description: Address all 7 issues from the code review: PAT encryption at rest, session expiry enforcement, dangling pointer fix in findRoute, async sleep in restartChild, nim.cfg passL cleanup with per-module pragmas, CSRF protection on POST routes, and CPU usage delta-based calculation.
steps: Fix issue 1: Add a TODO comment about PAT plaintext storage being accepted for v1, with a note about future encryption
Fix issue 2: Enforce session expiry in validateSession by comparing expires_at to current time
Fix issue 3: Change findRoute to return Option[ProxyRoute] value copy instead of ptr
Fix issue 4: Remove synchronous sleep from restartChild, add comment about deferred restart scheduling
Fix issue 5: Add {.passL.} pragmas to crypto.nim and remove --passL flags from nim.cfg
Fix issue 6: Add CSRF token generation and validation to dashboard POST routes
Fix issue 7: Fix getCpuUsage to take two samples with a short delay for delta-based calculation
Update tests to reflect changes (findRoute return type, CSRF tokens, session expiry)
acceptance_criteria: PAT storage has a TODO comment documenting the accepted limitation
validateSession rejects sessions past their expires_at timestamp
findRoute returns a value copy (Option[ProxyRoute]) not a pointer
restartChild does not call synchronous sleep
nim.cfg does not contain --passL flags; crypto.nim has {.passL.} pragmas
POST routes validate a CSRF token
getCpuUsage computes instantaneous CPU via delta sampling
verification: export PATH=/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/Doot && nim c src/doot.nim
export PATH=/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/Doot && nim c --threads:on --mm:orc --passL:-largon2 --passL:-lssl --passL:-lcrypto -r tests/test_dootd.nim
